title: Telescope with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Tripod legs -->
  <polygon points="50,62 38,92 42,93 52,65" fill="#8B6914"/>
  <polygon points="50,62 58,92 62,93 52,65" fill="#A0781A"/>
  <polygon points="50,62 48,93 52,93 52,65" fill="#C49A2A"/>
  
  <!-- Tripod hub -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="62" r="4" fill="#6B4F10"/>
  
  <!-- Main tube body -->
  <rect x="22" y="30" width="56" height="20" rx="6" fill="#4A90D9"/>
  
  <!-- Tube lighter top edge -->
  <rect x="22" y="30" width="56" height="6" rx="3" fill="#6BB0F5"/>
  
  <!-- Tube darker bottom band -->
  <rect x="22" y="44" width="56" height="6" rx="3" fill="#3A70B0"/>
  
  <!-- Front lens end (right) -->
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="40" rx="5" ry="12" fill="#5AA0E8"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="40" rx="3" ry="9" fill="#8EC8FF"/>
  <ellipse cx="78" cy="40" rx="2" ry="6" fill="#C0E4FF"/>
  
  <!-- Eyepiece end (left) -->
  <rect x="14" y="33" width="12" height="14" rx="4" fill="#3A70B0"/>
  <rect x="14" y="33" width="12" height="5" rx="2" fill="#5AA0E8"/>
  
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="39" r="4.5" fill="#1A2A4A"/>
  <circle cx="38" cy="39" r="3" fill="#88CCFF"/>
  <circle cx="39" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#E0F4FF"/>
  
  <circle cx="58" cy="39" r="4.5" fill="#1A2A4A"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="39" r="3" fill="#88CCFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#E0F4FF"/>
  
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M42 48 Q48 53 54 48" stroke="#FFD700" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="31" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FF90B0" opacity="0.7"/>
  <circle cx="65" cy="46" r="3" fill="#FF90B0" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Little star sparkle above -->
  <polygon points="80,18 82,23 87,23 83,26 85,31 80,28 75,31 77,26 73,23 78,23" fill="#FFE44D"/>
  <polygon points="20,16 21.5,19.5 25,19.5 22.3,21.5 23.5,25 20,23.5 16.5,25 17.7,21.5 15,19.5 18.5,19.5" fill="#FFE44D"/>
</svg>
